tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Claude documentation (the guides and the API reference together) by keyword or phrase. Returns matching pages and API endpoints ranked by relevance, with snippets showing context around matches.

tools.name: get_navigation
tools.description: Get the documentation navigation structure. Returns tabs, groups, and pages organized hierarchically. Useful for browsing available documentation topics.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Get the full content of a documentation page. Returns the page title, description, URL, and cleaned markdown content.

tools.name: get_api_endpoint
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific API endpoint including parameters, request body, and responses.
